description: RA-02 defense in depth for in-process role assumption. When a process runs with SYSTEM_ROLE (surface_runtime launches every surface with SYSTEM_ROLE=<surface id>; `pnpm surfaces` and `pnpm config-mission` set it for their own runtimes), withExecutionContext / withExecutionContextAsync may only assume the SYSTEM_ROLE itself, the shared core roles (narrow libs/core store-writer roles), or the roles listed for that system role here; anything else throws [ROLE_ASSUMPTION_DENIED]. A SYSTEM_ROLE without an entry may only assume itself. Processes without SYSTEM_ROLE are unaffected. Lists are derived from static reachability of withExecutionContext call sites (literal role arguments and the governed-artifact role wrappers) from each surface entry point; see knowledge/product/governance/AUTHORITY_MODEL.md section 3.B2.

shared_core_roles.rationale: Narrow roles that libs/core modules assume internally on behalf of every caller to write their own governed stores: infrastructure_sentinel (work coordination, peer messaging, mesh), knowledge_steward (mission creation), and the GovernedArtifactRole set of artifact-store / surface stores (chronos_gateway, slack_bridge, surface_runtime). The broad roles (ecosystem_architect, mission_controller, sovereign_concierge) are never shared: each system role lists them in may_assume with the modules that reach them.

Chronos viewer-scoped routes assume chronos_localadmin / chronos_operator (withViewerExecutionContext*, plugin-host-boot tenant registry reads); generation_scheduler via libs/core generation-scheduler. mission_controller: libs/core agent-identity, mission-dispatch-io, mission-lifecycle-service, mission-task-recovery, orchestrator-session, plugin-managed-install, provider-egress-gate, surface-mission-steering, task-scoped-grants, work-graph-projection, plugin-view-actions, surface-mission-proposals (plugin approvals and dispatch); ecosystem_architect: libs/core background-review-patch, storage-janitor; sovereign_concierge: libs/core authn-providers (viewer principal registry), browser-onboarding, slack-onboarding, tool-runtime-policy.
